name: frontend-interaction-design-plugin
description: Turns PRDs, durable prototype evidence, and API contracts into a Feishu-first review package and revision-pinned local frontend design snapshot without generating code.

interface.longDescription: Confirm the target frontend project and feature version, persist PRD, prototype, and API evidence outside the chat, clarify consequential ambiguity, generate traceable interaction models, publish a self-explanatory Feishu review document with lark-cli, and export a revision-pinned local engineering snapshot. The plugin never generates or modifies application code.
defaultPrompt: Turn this PRD, prototype, and API contract into a Feishu-first frontend design package.
Persist these prototype images in Feishu, clarify gaps, and generate a reviewable frontend plan.
Capture this Figma scope, publish the plan to Feishu, and export the confirmed revision locally.
